priority: rebuttal first, V2 quality in parallel
resource_policy: GPUs 0-7 allowed; at most one quality job per GPU; preserve other workloads; existing free-memory admission checks

stages.task: Fixed-time metal drop 25/12.5/6.25us; response summary comparison
stages.gate: Adjacent response difference <5% provisional screening; full trajectory/grid checks still required

stages.task: press/drop/stretch x 2 camera distances x 4 matched samples =24 simulations
stages.gate: empty <=1%, border <=5%, p10 area >=2% proposed; report per view and failures, do not silently discard

stages.task: 3 material families x 3 actions x 4 shapes x 2 stiffness values =72 simulations; finite trajectories, active deformation, aligned field/contact labels
stages.gate: No CUDA/NaN; report failure rate and material coverage; matched controls and independent objects

stages.task: Audit B/C/D bottleneck equality; isolate regularizers, stress/contact/flow controls; train only missing controls, 3 seeds
stages.gate: Same backbone/data/compute; val only selection; report object bootstrap, include null results

stages.task: Per-law scatter, replay comparisons, real-video small fixed benchmark, reproducibility table
stages.gate: No GT family at deployment; separate synthetic parameters from real replay error

stages.task: Physion video representation pilot; external particle data only for auxiliary dynamics, engine-specific labels
stages.gate: License/split/unit/engine audit before download; no shared raw E labels

stages.task: 4000 sample expansion then same backbone B/C/D 3 seeds; cross-engine few-shot afterward
stages.gate: Q1-Q3 plus held-out audit pass; no automatic escalation based on process exit alone
